refusedRequests: Two earlier runner executions were refused by SERV with 400 invalid_request_error before any generation (no response id, no usage). 1: reasoning_effort=low with function tools is not supported for the upstream model (fixed by leaving SERV_REASONING_EFFORT unset). 2: response_format schema used oneOf, which strict structured outputs refuse (fixed in ca59099). Recorded in evidence/journeys/j-2026-11-12-serv-document/refused-requests.json. The authorization counts a 4xx schema refusal before generation as nothing sent.
decisions: Evidence lives in evidence/journeys/<journeyId>/ (repository root), not docs/release/evidence/journeys/: scripts/release/journey-gate.mjs binds every artifact to <repo>/evidence/journeys/<journeyId>/ and refuses anything else.

The manifest is inside the journey directory (manifest.journey.json), not at evidence/journeys/*.journey.json: the gate CLI auto-discovers top-level manifests as the release journey, and this partial journey is bound to ca59099, so `pnpm release:journey` keeps reporting the release journey (none: every part NOT_RUN). docs/release/evidence/t058-journey-gate.json (all NOT_RUN) is unchanged and still describes that default.

sourceSha is the runner commit ca59099: the runner refuses a dirty tree and the gate binds sourceSha to HEAD, so the run was made at ca59099 and evaluated (file-only and --database against the throwaway database, via JOURNEY_DATABASE_URL) before the evidence was committed. At any later HEAD the same manifest FAILS with SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH; the gate was not changed and has no expected-SHA flag. tests/m14/t058-journey-serv-document.test.ts re-evaluates the committed manifest at its sourceSha on every verify.
A run whose proposal the product rejects is not offered to the gate as a reasoning part. The gate checks origin, artifacts, window and facts.runId only, so it would have read PASS for a rejected run.
The run budget was set to $0.25 (not $1.00) so that even one further worst-case turn after the budget check stays under the authorized cap.
The manual was re-fetched from the publisher URL because the copy named in the brief was missing from the scratchpad; its SHA-256 and size matched the brief before use.

findings: The journey gate PASSes a reasoning part for any SERV_REASONING origin with a runId, whatever the run's status; requiring facts.status COMPLETED (and a proposal digest) would close that. Not changed here.
The PDF parser's bounded subset extracts text in custom-encoded fonts as shifted glyph codes; parts of the XR60CX manual are unreadable to the model and to quote checks.
The model cited asset-snapshot data (the synthetic serial) with a manual citation id and an invented RECORD locator; the asset snapshot tool returns no citation, so such facts cannot be cited today.
The sourceSha ca59099 must stay reachable from main: merge with a merge commit, not squash or rebase.
secrets: The SERV key was passed only through the runner's environment. It is absent from every artifact, the product's stored model input/output, the gate outputs and the git diff (checked against the key file inside a script, never printed); the gate child process received no SERV key.
